capabilities: Insert a blinking clock block at the top of any note
Run a focus/break pomodoro timer in the sidebar that survives restarts
Open a designated homepage note on startup or by command
Render optional homepage blocks for links, pins, excerpts and recent notes
Scope title hiding and forced reading mode to the homepage and chosen notes
extras: Not yet in the community directory, so manual installation from release files is required. Phone layout is unverified on physical devices; desktop and mobile are otherwise supported. README is bilingual (English and Chinese).
motivation: The README explains design choices (theme variables, separate chaining switches, counter off by default) but does not state why the author built the plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no homepage concept and no built-in clock or focus timer, so a landing note is just an ordinary note unless something opens it.
summary: Adds a sidebar pomodoro timer, a decorative clock block for note tops, and a homepage note that opens at startup with scoped display rules.
